title: Zucchini, Mint and Halloumi Patties
subtitle: pan-fried until golden
description: Coarsely grated zucchini and onion are squeezed dry, mixed with halloumi, ricotta and mint, then pan-fried into golf-ball-sized patties. Squeezing the vegetables well is the key to patties that hold together.

steps.text: Coarsely grate the zucchini, onions and halloumi. Squeeze the zucchini and onions very well and place in a bowl.
Add the halloumi, chives, salt, ricotta, pepper, eggs, flour and breadcrumbs, and mix well. Chop the mint, add half and mix, then taste and add more mint, salt and pepper as needed.
Shape the mixture into ping-pong-ball-sized patties. If one falls apart in the pan, add another spoonful of breadcrumbs.
Heat olive oil in a wide frying pan. Fry the patties for 3 minutes, flip, cover the pan and fry for another 3 minutes. If frying in batches, add a spoonful of oil before each new batch.
